_doc: Wording for the day summary, the 'What now?' suggestions, story objectives and requests. Placeholders vary by key: {place} {town} {church} {name} {head} {n} {days} {good} {title} {step} {from} {what} {rel}.
sum.household.fed: The household is fed and well.
sum.household.grain: The larder holds grain for about {days} days.
sum.household.grain.low: Grain is running low: about {days} days left. Buy or mill some soon.
sum.household.grain.none: The larder is nearly bare of grain. Buy some at market before the family goes hungry.
sum.tomorrow.holy: Tomorrow is the holy day: no work, Mass in the morning and the butts after.
sum.tomorrow.chores: The household head sets new chores at dawn.
sug.hungry.pack: Eat something: you are hungry. Open your pack (I) and eat from it.
sug.hungry.home: Go home and eat: you are hungry.
sug.hungry.buy: Buy something to eat: you are hungry and have nothing in your pack.
sug.tired: Sleep: you are exhausted. Go home and rest.
sug.cold: Warm yourself: go home to the fire.
sug.dark: Go home: it is getting dark.
sug.market.day: It is market day in {town}. Visit the stalls to buy and sell.
sug.holy.butts: Then shoot at the butts: the whole village does on a holy day.
sug.perk: Choose a perk for {skill}: open the character sheet (Tab).
sug.request: {from} wants a word: they have something to ask of you.
sug.offer: {from} has work for you: go and speak to them.
sug.idle.wood: Nothing pressing. Gather firewood: the family can always use it.
sug.idle.butts: Nothing pressing. Practise at the butts and become an archer.
sug.idle.talk: Nothing pressing. Talk to your neighbours: they have news, work and advice.
sug.idle.home: Nothing pressing. Look in on your family at home.
story.ill.title: {name} is gravely ill
story.ill.why: {name} lies sick with a fever that may be the end of them. Be near them, and pray.
story.ill.visit.hint: Walk up to {name} and press E. Your presence is the kindest thing you can give.
story.ill.pray.hint: Hold E at the church and choose 'Pray'.
story.wedding.title: Your wedding feast
story.wedding.why: You and {name} are wed, and the parish gathers at the church door to feast with you.
story.wedding.step: Be at {church} for the wedding feast
story.wedding.hint: The feast begins at ten tomorrow morning and lasts an afternoon. Go to the church and mingle.
story.levy.title: The lord calls the levy
story.levy.why: {lord} calls the men of the manor to arms. A man who ignores the summons is fined and remembered.
story.levy.decide.hint: Open the command page (C) and choose to join the army or to refuse.
story.levy.report.hint: Follow the beacon to the muster. The army marches when it is gathered.
story.levy.reward: A soldier's pay and a place in the line
story.child.title: A child is born
story.child.why: {name} has been born to your household. The christening is in two days.
story.child.hint: Go home and see {name}: the household gathers round the cradle.
req.hear.hint: Walk up to {from} and press E. They will tell you what they need and you may agree or refuse.
req.fetch.have.hint: Buy it at the market, make it, or take it from your household's stores (I).
req.fetch.give.hint: Talk to {from} and choose to hand it over.
req.loan.wait.hint: There is nothing more to do: the lender waits for the borrower to pay.
req.work.hint: Any farm, garden, wood, stock or craft work in {place} counts.
req.message.hint: Travel to {place} (map: M), find {to} and talk to them.
req.animal.hint: Search the pasture and the wood in that direction: the animal is found when you stand near it.
req.watch.go: Keep watch over {place} through the night
req.watch.hint: Stay near the village from nightfall to dawn. The watch only counts while you are close.
req.godparent.hint: Be at the church on the day of the christening.
